name: Phil Izon
subject: My Analysis of the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD) Diversions
body:
Please share with friends and family | | | [](https://v8k6.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=69949840cacfbf0429faf423&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tropictundra.com%2F%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D699496b2ecbc1d5febae93a7%26ss_email_id%3D69949840cacfbf0429faf423%26ss_campaign_name%3DMy%2BAnalysis%2Bof%2Bthe%2BAlaska%2BPermanent%2BFund%2BDividend%2B%2528PFD%2529%2BDiversions%2B%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2026-02-17T16%253A33%253A52Z&w=658ac75703428575b106784b&c=b_699496b2ecbc1d5febae93a7&l=en-US&s=xNAptoSc8ox3ilE4js1i1H0DcBc%3D)
---
|
#### **My Analysis of the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD) Diversions (2016–2025)**
---
**Analysis of the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD) Diversions (2016–2025) Executive Summary Since fiscal year 2016, the State of Alaska has fundamentally altered the distribution of the Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD), shifting from a predictable statutory formula to a discretionary appropriation process. This policy shift has resulted in the diversion of approximately $25 billion from the Permanent Fund’s Earnings Reserve Account (ERA) to the General Fund and other state accounts. The primary takeaways from this analysis include: * The Scale of Diversion: Between 2016 and 2025, the cumulative gap between statutory PFD amounts and actual payouts (the "PFD shortfall") is estimated at $10.8 billion to $11.45 billion. The remaining portion of the $25 billion comprises broader ERA transfers used to fund government operations under the Percent of Market Value (POMV) framework. * Regressive Fiscal Impact: Economists and researchers characterize these diversions as a "regressive tax." Because the PFD is a flat, per-person payment, its reduction disproportionately burdens low-income and rural households, for whom the dividend constitutes a significant portion of annual income. * Impact on Future Generations: A child born in Alaska in 2016 is projected to lose approximately $42,577 in potential dividend income by the time they reach age 18 in 2034, assuming current legislative trends persist. * Economic Opportunity Costs: Analysis suggests that PFD cuts act as a drag on the private-sector economy. Estimates indicate a loss of roughly 725 full-time jobs for every $100 million in PFD reductions due to decreased consumer spending. * Legal and Political Rationale: The 2017 Alaska Supreme Court ruling in Wielechowski v. State affirmed that PFD appropriations are subject to legislative discretion. This provided legal clearance for the legislature to use dividend funds to bridge budget deficits caused by declining oil revenues.** 1\. The Mechanics of the PFD Diversion The Statutory Formula vs. Ad-Hoc Appropriations For decades, the PFD was calculated using a codified formula (AS 37.13.145 and AS 43.23.025) based on 21% of the Permanent Fund’s net income averaged over five fiscal years. In 2016, a pivotal shift occurred when Governor Bill Walker used a line-item veto to reduce the PFD to 1,022 (from a statutory estimate of ~2,052) to address a $3–4 billion budget deficit. Since that inflection point, the legislature has annually disregarded the statutory formula. The "diversion" represents the difference between the amount residents are entitled to under the 1982 law and the amount actually appropriated. Cumulative PFD Shortfalls (2016–2024) The following table illustrates the annual gap between the statutory formula and actual payouts:**Year - Statutory PFD (Est.) - Actual PFD PaidPer-Person Shortfall - Total Annual Diversion (Approx.)****2016- $2,052 - $1,022 - $1,030 - $665 Million****2017 -$2,300 -$1,100 - $1,200 -$771 Million****2018 -$2,900 -$1,600 - $1,300 - $821 Million****2019 -$3,004- $1,606 - $1,398 -$882 Million****2020 -$3,106- $992 - $2,114 - $1.328 Billion****2021 -$4,198- $1,114 - $3,084 -$1.918 Billion****2022 -$4,198 -$3,284* -$914 - $568 Million****2023 -$3,641 - $1,312 - $2,329 - $1.463 Billion****2024 -$3,644 -$1,702* - $1,942 - $1.214 Billion** *Includes one-time energy relief or supplemental payments.\-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 2. Reconciling the $25 Billion Total The $25 billion figure represents a comprehensive accounting of all Permanent Fund earnings directed away from dividends toward state stability, government services, or fund preservation since 2016. Components of the $25 Billion Total: 1. PFD Shortfalls (~$10.8B - $11.45B): The direct wealth transfer from residents resulting from reduced dividend checks. 2. Broader ERA Transfers (~$15.9B - $19.7B): Under Senate Bill 26 (2018), a structured Percent of Market Value (POMV) draw was established. The entire draw is first transferred from the ERA to the General Fund. The legislature then decides how much of that draw to "re-allocate" to PFDs. The portion not used for PFDs funds government operations. 3. Inflation-Proofing and Retention: Large sums (e.g., $1.45 billion in FY2019) are moved from the ERA to the Fund’s principal to protect it from inflation, which effectively removes those earnings from the pool available for current dividends. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 3. Socioeconomic Consequences The "Regressive Tax" Framing Economists characterize PFD reductions as the most regressive fiscal tool available to the state. Because the reduction is a flat amount per person, it consumes a much higher percentage of income for low-earning families than for the wealthy. * Low-Income Impact: A $2,200 diversion in 2024 represents a 17.6% tax on a family of four earning $50,000/year. * High-Income Impact: The same diversion represents only a 3.5% tax for a family of four earning $250,000/year. Because every Alaskan child is a designated shareholder of the state's resource wealth, the withholding of dividends is viewed by some researchers as the loss of a "birthright." Legislative and Legal Rationale The abandonment of the statutory formula was driven by a combination of fiscal necessity and political gridlock. * Legal Precedent: In 2017, the Alaska Supreme Court ruled in Wielechowski v. State that Permanent Fund earnings are subject to the "anti-dedication clause" of the state constitution. This means PFDs are not an automatic entitlement but are subject to the annual appropriation power of the governor and legislature. * The Stalemate on New Revenue: Legislators have been unable to reach a consensus on alternative revenues, such as a statewide income tax or sales tax. * Income Tax: Opposed as a penalty on labor and investment. * Sales Tax: Criticized for being regressive and administratively complex. * Oil Taxes: Proponents argue for higher severance taxes; opponents fear discouraging industry investment and reducing production volume. * Path of Least Resistance: Reducing the PFD became the "de facto revenue source of last resort" because it does not require a vote on a formal new tax. -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 7. It serves to: * Quantify the gap between "lawful" statutory amounts and actual payments. * Identify the specific legislative votes that enabled the diversions. * Highlight the redirection of wealth toward "unaccountable bureaucracies" and "NGO slush funds." On German soil, Ocasio-Cortez also accused Israel of committing "genocide" in Gaza, which author David Harris called "beyond obscene" and "disqualifying for her political ambitions."
* **The big picture:** The Munich trip comes as Ocasio-Cortez is considered a potential 2028 presidential frontrunner, making the stumbles particularly damaging. Bishop Robert Barron expressed concern that her framing of global issues as class struggle was "right out of the Marxist playbook," while Sen. Bernie Moreno quipped that she was "showcasing her lack of basic geography in Europe instead of spending time helping her constituents."

# **Trump pays tribute to Jesse Jackson while claiming civil rights icon "could not stand" Obama**
President Donald Trump reflected on his long relationship with Jesse Jackson following the civil rights activist's death at 84 on Tuesday, calling him "a good man, with lots of personality, grit, and 'street smarts'" while adding a pointed jab that **[Jackson"could not stand" former President Barack Obama](https://substack.com/redirect/5a0b6a5a-770c-47dd-8352-2825c2bafbc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** despite playing a significant role in his election.

body:
Democrats advance gun barrel regulation bill on party line vote
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
First off, if you didn't catch our Durango candidate forum last week, **[you MUST read this full recap](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**. No scripted soundbites. No safe, repeated answers. Featuring questions from YOU, our readers—on elections, immigration, crime, and more. [Check it out!](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Next, THE PODCAST IS BACK! Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏛️ **Under the Golden Dome...** Democrats advanced a [gun barrel regulation bill](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) on a party-line vote and introduced a proposal to [legalize prostitution statewide by July](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). A new report shows special interests [resisting prescription drug transparency reforms](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), while Colorado’s Medicaid board voted to [cap certain disability services](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after costs in one program surged more than 1,100% since 2018—highlighting mounting fiscal pressure.
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** At our [Durango forum](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), Republican candidates answered voter-submitted questions on taxes, energy, and rural control as caucus season begins. Newly released DOJ records also show [Rep. Diana DeGette’s name appearing in emails between Jeffrey Epstein and an associate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), though there’s no evidence she communicated directly with Epstein.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** Newly unsealed Watergate files show Richard Nixon[ faced internal espionage](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and 11 hours of grand jury testimony after his pardon. The Trump administration moved to [repeal the EPA’s 2009 “endangerment finding,”](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) prompting legal pushback from Colorado. [Colorado River negotiations collapsed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) amid drought and political division, and in Minnesota, a [federal immigration crackdown concluded](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) after local leaders shifted toward cooperation, signaling a strategic shift in enforcement.
This is your Mountain Minute for Tuesday, February 17, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Democrats advance gun barrel regulation bill on party line vote](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Gun barrels are not serialized. They are not a regulated “firearm” under federal law. But Colorado lawmakers are preparing to vote on whether they should be treated more like one.
The bill sponsored by Sen. Tom Sullivan of Centennial, would require barrels to be sold through a federally licensed dealer instead of privately. Dealers would keep purchase records for five years. Violations could carry fines — and up to 30 days in county jail.
The proposal advanced out of committee on a narrow vote and now heads to the full Senate. Supporters describe it as the next step after last year’s ghost gun legislation. Critics argue it regulates a part that cannot be traced.
At the center of the debate: whether regulating barrels meaningfully reduces crime — or simply adds paperwork. The bill is short. The debate around it is not.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[At Durango forum, GOP candidates field rotating questions submitted from across Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* ******Durango forum flips the script on candidate debates:** Instead of recycled talking points, GOP candidates fielded rotating, voter-submitted questions from across Colorado, creating sharper contrasts and more unscripted exchanges.

* **Election integrity, crime, taxes and border security take center stage:** Secretary of State hopefuls called for machine decertification and greater transparency, while Senate and governor candidates emphasized lower taxes, tougher enforcement, and stronger cooperation with federal immigration authorities.

* **Grassroots energy builds ahead of caucus season:** With 62 questions submitted statewide and the event livestreamed beyond Durango, the forum highlighted growing voter engagement and early fault lines in key Republican primaries.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[The High Cost of Ignorance: Why Special Interests Are Fighting Prescription Drug Transparency in Colorado](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY REP. KEN DEGRAAF, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* ******HB26-1056 pushes drug pricing transparency for employers:** Rep. Ken DeGraaf argues the bill would require Pharmacy Benefit Managers to disclose real cost data, empowering self-insured employers to access lower-cost, compliant drug sourcing options.

* **Special interests fight disclosure as billions are at stake:** The commentary highlights opposition from major pharmaceutical companies, trade groups, and pharma-funded patient organizations, arguing transparency threatens entrenched rebate and pricing structures.

* **Bill does not create new import loopholes, sponsor says:** DeGraaf contends HB26-1056 simply protects existing federal importation rights and fiduciary duties under ERISA, rejecting claims that it promotes risky “alternative funding” schemes.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Faith Over Feelings: The Rules of Engagement – Flight Line to Living Room](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY DRAKE HUNTER | COMMENTARY | FEBRUARY 15** _In the Air Force, Rules of Engagement were never suggestions. They weren’t emotional guidelines. They were commands—clearly defined before the pressure ever came. When executing missions on the flight line, especially in dangerous areas, you can’t decide in the moment what feels right._
**[Buyers walk free, survivors carry the scars: Colorado debates sentencing for child traffickers](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | FEBRUARY 13** Colorado lawmakers confronted a question this week that has lingered for years under the gold dome: how far should the state go in punishing those who buy and traffic children? Two bills offered two different answers.
**[CMU student leaders press governor hopefuls on taxes, energy and rural control](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | FEBRUARY 12** _TPUSA chapter leaders from Colorado Mesa University opened Monday night’s gubernatorial forum with a question more typical of a legislative hearing than a campaign rally. Instead of easing into the forum, they went straight to TABOR. “How would you approach balancing Colorado’s budget while complying with TABOR? And what are your priorities when it comes to taxes, refunds and state spending during periods of surplus and economic stagnation?”_ __

body:
I’m calling on the Justice Department to follow the law and stop redacting information that isn’t related to protecting victims.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20260217-5922-footer&t=1&akid=5922%2E420207%2EZEfb6v)
Peter,
Jeffrey Epstein abused and exploited young girls, and survivors have spent almost two decades demanding accountability from every powerful person and institution that enabled him.
The least Congress can do is insist on the full truth. That’s why I confronted AG Pam Bondi to apologize in this week’s hearing, and voted to release the files despite the Trump administration and House leadership trying to stall, muddy the waters, and run out the clock. Because I believe no one — rich, connected, or politically protected — should be above the law.
But the Justice Department slow-walked the full release of the files, and what they have released contains thousands of redactions — all in violation of the law.
**We need to demand full justice for the survivors. I’m calling on the Justice Department to stop surveilling Members of Congress, follow the law, and stop redacting information that isn’t related to protecting victims.**
[**If you agree, sign on to my petition today demanding the Justice Department stop protecting the powerful and pursue justice for victims.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/pj-em-20260216-epstein-files/?source=em20260217-5922&t=2&akid=5922%2E420207%2EZEfb6v)

Enough is enough.
In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

subject: The far-right wants to give teachers less and less. I’ll give them more.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY SWANSON FOR GOVERNOR
body:
I was honored to speak at a forum hosted by the Michigan Education Association

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125570940/602212376/-1880432604?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTYxNzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjhlMzAyYWEtMjMwYy1mMTExLTgzMmUtMDAyMjQ4MmE5NzMzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xEA2yCGYuZofxno3NUnxelmqBeuGbHtoHIBPmjEIdV0=&emci=8f3e0ccd-3b08-f111-832e-0022482a9733&emdi=68e302aa-230c-f111-832e-0022482a9733&ceid=27644625) I was honored to speak at a forum hosted by the Michigan Education Association — our state’s largest union of teachers, education support professionals, and higher-education employees. These days, a lot of far-right politicians love to treat teachers and educators as an afterthought — to insult and degrade their profession and tell them to do more with less and less. [**But it’s not rocket science: We have to pay professionals like these educators a professional wage. A living wage. And I’ll get it done as your Governor.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125570942/602212382/-1343262757?refcode=email_021726_teachers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTYxNzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjhlMzAyYWEtMjMwYy1mMTExLTgzMmUtMDAyMjQ4MmE5NzMzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xEA2yCGYuZofxno3NUnxelmqBeuGbHtoHIBPmjEIdV0=) [_**I hope you’ll take a moment to hear my remarks at the Michigan Education Association’s forum — then chip in to send a champion of public education to the Governor’s office.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125570943/602212388/-1343262757?refcode=email_021726_teachers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTYxNzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjhlMzAyYWEtMjMwYy1mMTExLTgzMmUtMDAyMjQ4MmE5NzMzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xEA2yCGYuZofxno3NUnxelmqBeuGbHtoHIBPmjEIdV0=) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125570944/602212395/-1343262757?refcode=email_021726_teachers&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjEvMS8xMTYxNzAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjhlMzAyYWEtMjMwYy1mMTExLTgzMmUtMDAyMjQ4MmE5NzMzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=xEA2yCGYuZofxno3NUnxelmqBeuGbHtoHIBPmjEIdV0=) Thanks for stepping up, Chris Swanson

**American healthcare reacts to crises, rather than prevent them**
_When patients control resources, healthcare system work for them, rather than around them._
**By** Charles Sauer

* * *

Healthcare is intensely personal, and when devastating news arrives in the exam room, lives and families are changed in an instant. Yet a system bogged down by regulation and bureaucracy too often compounds that pain, forcing patients to navigate the most frightening chapter of their lives alone. We must change that.
That’s why President Trump’s plan to fund patients – not the system – is revolutionary. Shifting power from government bureaucrats, insurance companies, and big hospital systems will allow Americans to make their own healthcare decisions. When patients control the resources, the healthcare system begins to work for them rather than around them.
Today, one of the clearest examples of why this approach matters is Alzheimer’s disease.
In a powerful **[Wall Street Journal op-ed](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)** , Dr. Brent Beasley recounts how he was diagnosed with Alzheimer’s at age 57 after losing his job due to unexplained cognitive struggles. Despite being a physician with significant medical knowledge and strong connections, securing a diagnosis took nearly a year – precious time when early intervention can make a life-changing difference.
But Dr. Beasley’s story is not one of despair. It’s one of hope.
Because his disease was detected early enough, his care team successfully intervened. Treatment helped him regain clarity, remain active in his church, and live a purposeful life. His experience is deeply encouraging. You can read his story **[here](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**.
**An Alzheimer’s diagnosis no longer has to mean immediate decline.**
Science is opening doors that did not exist a decade ago. Yet Dr. Beasley’s story demonstrates that America’s healthcare system is largely designed to react to crises rather than prevent them. Patients are often diagnosed too late even though early interventions and lifestyle changes can have profound impacts.
Removing barriers to early testing, expanding access to innovative treatments, and supporting caregivers must become a national priority.
There is another reason policymakers should pay attention.
Analysts, including President Trump’s former Domestic Policy Advisor Joe Grogan and Paragon Research Fellow Ryan Long, increasingly **[warn that Alzheimer’s is not only a medical challenge but an economic one](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)**. Without a serious strategy, the growing number of Alzheimer’s cases could strain families, shrink the workforce, and place additional pressure on federal programs.
**China has a plan. Where’s America’s Plan?**
China has launched a national Alzheimer’s effort focused on awareness, screening, and early intervention. America needs a similar focus. The health and wellness of our citizens and the fiscal strength of our nation are at stake.
The encouraging news is that the path forward is becoming clearer. It must include:
* Detecting the disease earlier
* Empowering primary care doctors
* Supporting innovation
* Reducing bureaucratic obstacles
* Putting patients back at the center of care

With the right strategy, America can lead the world by extending not just lifespan, but healthspan, allowing millions to remain active contributors to their families, communities, and economies.
Dr. Beasley reminds us that behind every policy debate is a human story and hope is no longer theoretical. Now the question is whether we will learn from stories like his and act boldly to help families facing an Alzheimer’s diagnosis.

* * *

**About the Author:**
_Charles Sauer is the president of the Market Institute, and the author of Profit Motive: What Drives the Things We Do._

name: Jack Schlossberg
subject: My grandfather, JFK
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021626_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021626_1]
Lately, I've been doing some reflecting on my grandfather, President John F. Kennedy, and his legacy of hope.
In my run to fight for NY-12 in Congress, and just as a person, that's what I want to focus on. Hope.
My name is Jack, or John Bouvier Kennedy Schlossberg if you want to know the whole thing.
In high school, I spent hours watching my grandfather's speeches. He taught us all that politics isn't about serving yourself — it's about serving others. When we fight for hope, we're not just doing it for ourselves, we're doing it for each other and the future we all have to share.
I know I have big shoes to fill. In my grandfather's memory, I've led a life of caring about this a lot. I put that care and effort and hope into everything I do.
But this is bigger than me. It's bigger than my family's legacy.
Hope is hard to find in Politics these days, but if we let it die out completely, that's how we really lose. Now cannot be the time to stop caring or turn away. We have to double down in our pursuit of hope.
I really think this election is the one — our last chance to stop Trump and change the direction we're heading in.
I need you to know that I believe we can do it. I believe in hope, and I believe in us. Will you believe with me? You can make a difference by splitting a donation between our campaign for NY-12 and Outrage then Action PAC today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rtp-2025-jack?refcode=021626_1]

We SHUT DOWN Trump’s Department of Homeland Security.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. subject: My thoughts on New Hampshire and the future
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
Trump’s administration is doing real damage. New Hampshire could be our last, best chance to stop him.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/221?c0=em_ms_cp_20260217_1.QOPuMM&refcode=em20260217-1&t=1&akid=5160%2E582294%2EBzsMOd)
Governor JB Pritzker here.
Let me be blunt: **_Everything we care about is on the line in 2026 — and New Hampshire could decide the outcome._**
We’ve already seen the damage Trump’s second term is inflicting on our country: His ICE agents are once again targeting families in broad daylight -- tearing apart communities, rounding up workers, and instilling fear across entire neighborhoods. He’s gutting environmental protections while utility rates spike, forcing working families to foot the bill so his billionaire donors can cash out.
He has no interest in bipartisanship, decency, or democracy. **And if Democrats don’t take back the Senate this November, there will be nothing stopping him.** That’s why we _must_ win in New Hampshire.
**[Chris Pappas is running in a tied race that could decide Senate control. Chip in $5 now to help him win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260217_1.wDmrCy&refcode=em20260217-1&t=2&akid=5160%2E582294%2EBzsMOd)**
Trump and his MAGA allies are laser-focused on New Hampshire. They’ve recruited a big-name candidate, they’re lining up GOP billionaire donors, and they know if they win here, they’ll shut the door on a Democratic Senate majority.
We can’t let that happen.
Chris Pappas is a fighter. He’s taken on Big Pharma, defended reproductive freedom, and delivered for working families in one of the toughest districts in the country.
I want him in the Senate. But we’re all going to have to come together to get him there. He’s running in a true battleground. His race is tied. And the GOP machine, desperate to keep Democrats locked out of power, is ready to bury him in dark money and attack ads.
**[That’s why I’m asking-- urgently -- for your help: Can you chip in $5 to help Chris Pappas win in New Hampshire and give us a fighting chance to stop Trump?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260217_1.wDmrCy&refcode=em20260217-1&t=3&akid=5160%2E582294%2EBzsMOd)**

The damage is real. The stakes are massive. And the time to act is right now.
Thank you for standing with Chris and for standing up to the madness.
JB Pritzker
Governor of Illinois
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

---
| I mentioned Crossover above; today, all Senate bills must be completed to cross over into the House. **Crossover marks the halfway point of legislative session**. While we work through Crossover, **_Democrats are still trying and failing to grapple with the concept of 'affordability'._** The first half of legislative session saw them introduce **_over 50 new or increased taxes._** The Democratic party is attempting to tack additional taxes on everyday goods and services like dry cleaning, car repairs, dog-walking and grooming, even digital content like streaming services! Rest assured that **our caucus is fighting tooth and nail to stop their sham “affordability” docket** , which is made up of tax increases, gun bans, and gerrymandering attempts. Doesn't sound very affordable to me. Along with these excessive taxes, **Democrats are still going after our 2nd amendment rights.** Remember how they always said they “aren't trying to take your guns” and that the idea of them pushing a firearm license was “ludicrous” or even “a conspiracy theory”? Well, they seem to have forgotten. Last week, we saw a slew of anti-second-amendment legislation get shoved through the process and voted off the Senate floor: 21-19, party line, every single one. **_We 're counting on you_** to reach out to members of the House and Senate who voted yes on these bills to help them understand why exactly this is such a big deal to so many Virginians.
---
|
---
| Horrible policy aside, I'm happy to say my office has received**a lot** of visitors from all over the 28th district! Legislative session is a great time to come and talk to me and members of my staff about upcoming legislation! Call me, email me, write me a letter, or come visit in person!**_Sen. Bryce Reeves_**** _201 N. 9th St._****_Rm. 614_**** _Richmond, VA 23219_**

name: Autism Health
subject: Join Us for Our Upcoming Fundraiser this Saturday!
body:
Hearts & Vines Wine Tasting Fundraiser!

Please save the date for our Hearts & Vines Fundraiser, an elegant evening benefiting Autism Health Inc., proudly sponsored by Sunstone Winery (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/sunstonewinery.com/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/1/L9kY92nqC0?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

If you are local to San Diego, please join us on Saturday, February 21st, from 5 PM to 9 PM PST in San Marcos, CA for a special night of community, connection, and purpose. Guests will enjoy fine wine, delicious hors d'oeuvres, and inspiring presentations from Dr. Sabine Hazan, (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/progenabiome.com/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/2/Jdir5VV9gt?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) Dr. Dayan Goodenowe (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/drgoodenowe.com/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/3/wuoiw7DRLR?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and Gabrielle Traub (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/www.sandiegohomeopathy.com%2Fstaff.htm/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/4/_7X3u5AVVf?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) , who will share insights on fecal transplant, plasmalogens, homeopathy, autism, health, and the most up-to-date research.

Tickets are $95 and include wine, hors d'oeuvres, and a complimentary wine glass. There will also be a silent auction with amazing items to bid on.

This intimate fundraising event supports Autism Health Inc.’s mission to advance education, research, and resources for families impacted by autism and neurological disorders.

We look forward to sharing this meaningful evening with you!
REGISTER HERE (https://givebutter.com/2026_HnV?gbtid=f3ff79e2-33f6-4022-869c-2756e1795e1f&mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID)

** The 2026 Autism Health Summit is Almost Here!
------------------------------------------------------------

April 24–26, 2026 | Legacy Center Resort & Spa | San Diego, California

The Autism Health Summit is our flagship educational event, bringing together leading voices in research, medicine, advocacy, and integrative health for three powerful days of learning, connection, and collaboration. This annual gathering is designed for parents, practitioners, researchers, and advocates who are seeking deeper insight into autism and neurological health from a whole-body, whole-family perspective.

We are honored to welcome an extraordinary lineup of speakers, including Aaron Siri, Del Bigtree, Dr. Toby Rogers, Dr. Sabine Hazan, Dr. Dayan Goodenowe, Ed Clay, and many more respected experts and thought leaders. Together, they will explore cutting-edge research, clinical insights, environmental factors, and practical strategies that families and professionals can use. For a full list of speakers, click HERE to see our agenda (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fahsconference.com%252Fagenda%252F%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F1%2FeR-lkap3k2/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/6/87op-3RVgs?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) .

The Summit will be held at the beautiful Legacy Center Resort & Spa (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Flegacyresortandspa.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F2%2FcmuIWlIP_Q/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/7/m2rpbaDNTS?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) , where attendees can book a room at a special group rate of $199 per night. To reserve your room, please use the conference room block link HERE (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fahsconference.com%252Fhotel%252F%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F3%2FR1Eh7nj6ve/b43o/xXbDAQ/AQ/0a6f4160-371b-4bac-b369-4fde697d162c/8/4LBUCPvrxv?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) or call (619) 782-9155 and use block code: Autism26.

For the month of February only, we are offering a discount code Valentine50 to receive $50 off your in-person admission ticket. Don't miss out on this special offer!

We look forward to welcoming you to San Diego for an unforgettable weekend of education, empowerment, and community.
REGISTER HERE (https://ahsconference.com/pricing-table/?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID)

We are deeply grateful to our top sponsors for their continued support and leadership: Cellular Performance Institute (CPI) (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fcellularperformanceinstitute.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F4%2FsxItfHHc49/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/10/I6UnIyEykc?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) , Dr. Goodenowe Enterprises (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Fdrgoodenowe.com%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F5%2F7zPRt-ypBb/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/11/xhNw8zSxyz?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) , European Wellness (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/track.pstmrk.it%2F3s%2Feuropean-wellness.eu%2Fb43o%2FXYvCAQ%2FAQ%2Ffb66b930-9caa-4773-b075-95fc5d58a8e8%2F6%2FUZE-tepvnv/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/12/opfkF7ILLH?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) , and Satellite Phone Store (https://track.pstmrk.it/3s/satellitephonestore.com/b43o/alXDAQ/AQ/7a03c33c-0a30-4692-ad61-f7d0e8ee69ec/13/Evqe0_cBgm?mc_cid=e67bd232c9&mc_eid=UNIQID) . Diet & Nutrition: How Nutrition Helps Individuals with Neurological Disorders

Join us on Saturday, February 28th at 9:00 AM PST / 12:00 PM EST for an incredible educational webinar, “Diet & Nutrition: How Nutrition Helps Individuals with Neurological Disorders,” featuring Julie Matthews, M.S. In this powerful session, Julie will share how targeted, therapeutic nutrition can support brain health, reduce inflammation, and improve overall function in individuals with neurological challenges. She will explain how food sensitivities, nutrient deficiencies, gut health, and metabolic imbalances can influence behavior, cognition, and development.

This webinar will highlight an important message we consistently share at Autism Health: nutrition is foundational. When we address underlying biological needs through strategic dietary interventions, we create a stronger platform for healing and progress. We invite parents, caregivers, and health-conscious individuals to join us for this informative and empowering discussion.

body:

# February Victory Update from Kevin
---
| | Dear Friend and Patriot,
I hope this email finds you and your family well. I'm truly grateful for the incredible support we're seeing across Michigan as **we continue to build toward the February county conventions and the March endorsement convention**. It's an honor to earn the support of grassroots Republicans like you who are fighting for our shared America First values.This past week has brought more strong momentum for our campaign:
✅ [I joined Trucker Randy’s radio show on Friday lay out **real solutions** on illegal immigration](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=51fc197341&e=4b10910eed) and d**angerous sanctuary policies**. My plan as Attorney General is clear: audit sanctuary cities, notify them of constitutional violations, and — if they refuse to take actions to protect their citizens — t**ake immediate legal action to protect Michigan citizens**. Even one preventable tragedy is one too many. We also hammered home the need to **defend Second Amendment rights** and **end partisan lawfare once and for all**. Click on the image below to listen:
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=f38bc6331b&e=4b10910eed)
| | | | | | | | | | | | ✅ **Huge Macomb County Turnout** : [I spoke yesterday to a packed house of fired-up Republicans at The Palazzo Grande in Shelby Township](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=5497c0fec1&e=4b10910eed). Attendees were signing up on the spot to become 2026 precinct delegates, and the energy was through the roof. Massive thanks to Shelby Township Clerk Stanley Grot for organizing this powerhouse event—and I’m **proud to share that both Stan Grot** and**Macomb County Commissioner Sylvia Grot have officially endorsed our campaign for Michigan Attorney General**.
The Grot family’s support sends a powerful message: we are uniting behind proven America First leadership to **restore public safety** , **defend our constitutional rights** , **secure our elections** , and **end partisan lawfare**. Macomb is ready to lead the charge to turn Michigan ruby red.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=496aca997c&e=4b10910eed)
| [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=c3307694a3&e=4b10910eed)
| [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=0f05d5bb76&e=4b10910eed)
| | ✅ [**We continued the surge in Oakland County** yesterday with a great crowd at the Troy Republican Committee meeting](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=421b8b9c0c&e=4b10910eed) at McVee’s Pub. Sharing the stage **with James David Dickson** , we drove home the truth: this race isn’t just another election—i**t’s a must-win battle** to make politics local again and restore the rule of law. The resolve in that room to put Michigan families first was unmistakable.
---
| | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=44ca9f6abb&e=4b10910eed)
| [|
---](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=8fec56ae46&e=4b10910eed)
| | ✅ **Hold Consumers Energy Accountable** : [I called out CEO Garrick Rochow for brushing off skyrocketing electric rates](https://kevinformi.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=39782b0ca6b504d2faad7a196&id=6ae329dae5&e=4b10910eed) as mere political “deadcatting” while Michigan families pay bills rising faster than inflation — and higher than 46 other states. As your Attorney General, I will aggressively enforce consumer protection laws, investigate unfair pricing, demand real transparency, and fight for true competition — **not endless rate hikes shielded by establishment influence**.
---
| | **Let’s Keep Winning for Michigan Families!**
Your increasing support reflect the energy we're seeing statewide. As Michigan’s Attorney General, I'll deliver proven results: restoring trust in elections, standing up for parental rights, backing law enforcement, and delivering courtroom results against government overreach — just like I did **dismissing charges against President Trump's alternate electors** and **keeping high schools open during COVID lockdowns**.
Thank you for your continued support and commitment to making Michigan red again. I'm honored to earn your support at the March convention — together, we'll secure this nomination and win big in November.
Very truly yours,Kevin Kijewski
Republican Candidate for Michigan Attorney General

Because of your continued commitment, we are pushing back against the Trump administration's efforts to chip away at our rights. We are challenging extreme abortion bans at the state level, removing barriers that deny millions of women access to essential care, and shifting how the world understands abortion and reproductive freedom—because these rights are nothing less than basic human rights. You are part of this work. We could not do it without you. Thank you for your dedication and for being a constant presence in this movement. Together, we will do even more in 2026 to protect and expand reproductive rights. For reproductive rights, Nancy Northup President & CEO P.S. # California gas prices spiral as refinery crisis deepens
California drivers are reeling as average gas prices **[surged 40 cents per gallon in just two weeks to $4.58,](https://substack.com/redirect/496e64a1-d2c9-4702-9f33-c9cb7422b949?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** far outpacing the national average of $2.92, driven by shrinking refining capacity from the Valero Benicia refinery wind-down and prior Phillips 66 closure in Los Angeles.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/496e64a1-d2c9-4702-9f33-c9cb7422b949?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Refinery Capacity Shrinks** : Valero's Benicia facility in Northern California is winding down operations, leaving the state with only six active refineries and tightening overall fuel supply.
* **Statewide Price Jump** : Prices climbed from $4.18 two weeks ago to $4.46 last week and now $4.58, making California the most expensive state for gas, topping Hawaii and Washington.
* **Political Pushback Grows** : Republican state senators, led by Suzette Martinez Valladares, call California at a "breaking point" and urge Gov. Newsom to hold a special session on oil and gas policies.
* **Volatility Warning Issued** : Experts and lawmakers predict more instability and price swings ahead without swift action to address diminishing in-state production and supply constraints.

# Goldman Sachs bends the knee, axes woke DEI board criteria
Goldman Sachs **[plans to strip"other demographics" references](https://substack.com/redirect/e1b4feb2-25f4-477e-bcbd-ebdcc57f94dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**--including race, gender identity, ethnicity and sexual orientation--from its board candidate evaluation criteria this month, bowing to conservative pressure amid President Trump's sweeping anti-woke push that has accelerated corporate retreats from diversity policies across America.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/e1b4feb2-25f4-477e-bcbd-ebdcc57f94dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Conservative Pressure Deal** : Goldman Sachs agreed to the change after a September request from the National Legal and Policy Center, a conservative nonprofit shareholder, avoiding a formal proposal at the upcoming annual meeting.
* **Narrowed Diversity Focus** : The bank's board criteria will now emphasize traditional diversity in viewpoints, background, work experience and military service, dropping explicit demographic tags.
* **Prior Policy Shift** : Last year Goldman Sachs already eliminated board diversity mandates for companies it takes public, signaling an earlier step back from DEI commitments.
* **Trump 's Broader Influence** : The move aligns with Trump's executive orders dismantling federal DEI programs and his March declaration ending "woke" policies in government, military and private sector, fueling wider corporate rejection of such initiatives.

# Iran partially shuts Hormuz chokepoint, oil prices shrug it off and head lower
Iran temporarily **[partially closed the vital Strait of Hormuz](https://substack.com/redirect/30f5d2ef-7e13-4c6d-99ca-9b4dc1859165?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for Revolutionary Guards military drills Tuesday as indirect nuclear talks with the United States wrapped up in Geneva without a deal but with agreement on guiding principles, signaling ongoing high-stakes tensions over Tehran's nuclear program amid regional military posturing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/30f5d2ef-7e13-4c6d-99ca-9b4dc1859165?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Hormuz Partial Closure:** Iran enacted a temporary partial shutdown of the Strait of Hormuz for security during live-firing naval exercises, causing only minor shipping delays without major global oil disruptions.
* **Nuclear Talks Progress:** Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced an understanding on main guiding principles after serious discussions in Geneva, though he stressed more work remains before any agreement.
* **Oil Market Reaction:** Brent crude futures dropped 1.8% to $67.48 and WTI fell 0.4% to $62.65 per barrel as markets shrugged off the closure and focused on the talks' inconclusive end.
* **Context of Tensions:** The action marks the first such Strait measure since US threats of military action in January, occurring against a backdrop of US military buildup and Iran's deterrence demonstrations.

# Pritzker quits Hyatt Executive Chairman role over Epstein ties
Hyatt Hotels executive chairman Thomas J. Pritzker abruptly retired from the board Monday, citing deep regret for **[maintaining post-2008 contact with Jeffrey Epstein](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd1c5d1-db00-4d86-8de3-8350bcae03cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd1c5d1-db00-4d86-8de3-8350bcae03cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)and Ghislaine Maxwell after new documents revealed their friendly exchanges, with CEO Mark Hoplamazian stepping in as chair to protect the company amid mounting scrutiny.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd1c5d1-db00-4d86-8de3-8350bcae03cc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Regretful admission** : Pritzker condemned Epstein and Maxwell's actions, expressed sorrow for victims, and admitted "terrible judgment" in not distancing himself sooner from the pair.
* **Board transition** : The Hyatt board immediately appointed CEO Mark Hoplamazian to succeed Pritzker as chairman, combining the roles while Pritzker steps away entirely.
* **No reelection planned** : Pritzker, who served over two decades since 2004, will not seek reelection at the upcoming annual shareholder meeting.
* **Broader trend** : His exit follows similar high-profile resignations by executives like former Goldman Sachs legal chief Kathryn Ruemmler, driven by Epstein file distractions.

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The message Charlie carried into eternity
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tamad6&__onlt=h)
---

**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

body:
Your prayer is important as your Oregon legislature considers bills this February

| | | | | [|
---](https://harbickfororegon.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ed96bc27b78bb6b7e94ca23a&id=cb41ba68f4&e=3362c31595)
| | Peter,

Hello from Darin! We are halfway through the 2026 legislative session and there are several bills still in process that you should be aware of. We are asking that you pray, so that this legislative body makes the right choices for all Oregonians. Some of these bills are blatantly immoral, some of these bills are unconstitutional, and some of these bills are not wise because they take away Oregonians’ rights and remove accountability from our lawmakers. **SB 4088** would further allow the practice of so called, “gender-affirming” care, and would prohibit cooperation with federal law enforcement investigations, including infractions of interstate activity. Curtailing parental rights, this continues Oregon’s practice of irreversible physical damage to minors, and would also allow judges to order a legal change of sex upon a person’s request. **HB 4127** provides a method for the state of Oregon to continue to pay prohibited companies such as Planned Parenthood, even though such companies have been barred from receiving federal funds because they practice abortions. Because federal H.R. 1 prohibited federal Medicaid funds from being used to reimburse any company that continues to perform abortions, Planned Parenthood is asking for funds from Oregon taxpayers. **SB 1599** has received the most news this last year, when more than 250,000 Oregon voters voted to refer the “ODOT” tax increase to the November ballot so that the people of Oregon could vote on its passage. This was after more than 90% of submitted testimony was against the bill. Unfortunately, after this overwhelmingly show of disapproval, the Oregon legislature is pushing a change from the November ballot to the May ballot, a time that the majority party states is more favorable to them. This is a direct repudiation of the will of the people, and against the very spirit and wording of the passed initiative. **HB 4015** disconnects Oregon from several federal tax credits enacted by H.R. 1. In a time when Oregonians are already suffering from high taxes, this bill would take back roughly $311 million in tax relief. Workers should be allowed to keep more of their money, so they can use and invest as they see fit, rather than giving even more money to our government. **SJR 201** would also effectively raise our taxes by keeping “Kicker” refunds from being returned to taxpayers. When the state of Oregon collects even more tax revenue than projected from the year before, the state is constitutionally required to return the extra taxes to taxpayers. Again, taxpayers should be allowed to keep more of their money, rather than legislators deciding to arbitrarily our hard-earned wages. **HB 4145** further erodes Oregonian’s 2nd amendment rights. This bill modifies the 2022 ballot measure 114 that curtailed the right to bear arms and increases fees and length of time to receive a permit to apply for a firearm to protects one’s family. Creating a database of permit holders, this bill creates even more regulations and obstacles to a constitutionally guaranteed right. **HB 4079** forces every school district to contact students, parents and the community anytime a federal immigration officer enters school property. Increasing Oregon’s sanctuary laws that keep local law enforcement from working with federal law enforcement, this mandates that every school must disrupt the school day with the notification, regardless of the work being carried out. For more information on these bills, proceed to [https://olis.oregonlegislature.gov/liz/2026R1](https://harbickfororegon.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5ed96bc27b78bb6b7e94ca23a&id=96852518af&e=3362c31595) click on the “Bills” icon at the top right, and enter the bill number for more information. Again, we ask that you please pray for our state legislators so that we make right decisions and allow Oregon to be the best state that it can be for our families. Thank you for your prayers and support, and please reach out to me if I can be of service!
---
| | | | | |
Darin Harbick

Unfortunately, after this overwhelmingly show of disapproval, the Oregon legislature is pushing a change from the November ballot to the May ballot, a time that the majority party states is more favorable to them. This is a direct repudiation of the will of the people, and against the very spirit and wording of the passed initiative. HB 4015 disconnects Oregon from several federal tax credits enacted by H.R. 1. In a time when Oregonians are already suffering from high taxes, this bill would take back roughly $311 million in tax relief. Workers should be allowed to keep more of their money, so they can use and invest as they see fit, rather than giving even more money to our government. SJR 201 would also effectively raise our taxes by keeping “Kicker” refunds from being returned to taxpayers. When the state of Oregon collects even more tax revenue than projected from the year before, the state is constitutionally required to return the extra taxes to taxpayers. Again, taxpayers should be allowed to keep more of their money, rather than legislators deciding to arbitrarily our hard-earned wages. HB 4145 further erodes Oregonian’s 2nd amendment rights. This bill modifies the 2022 ballot measure 114 that curtailed the right to bear arms and increases fees and length of time to receive a permit to apply for a firearm to protects one’s family. Creating a database of permit holders, this bill creates even more regulations and obstacles to a constitutionally guaranteed right. HB 4079 forces every school district to contact students, parents and the community anytime a federal immigration officer enters school property. Increasing Oregon’s sanctuary laws that keep local law enforcement from working with federal law enforcement, this mandates that every school must disrupt the school day with the notification, regardless of the work being carried out. For more information on these bills, proceed to click on the “Bills” icon at the top right, and enter the bill number for more information. Again, we ask that you please pray for our state legislators so that we make right decisions and allow Oregon to be the best state that it can be for our families. Thank you for your prayers and support, and please reach out to me if I can be of service! | | | | | | Darin Harbick | | | | | | | | | | Paid for by Harbick for Oregon ID 23118 Copyright (C) 2026 Harbick for Oregon. Beshear on possible election interference = = Peter, Donald Trump has threatened to "nationalize" elections in key blue areas, and it's important to understand what that really means. He's talking about putting the federal government in charge of state and local elections in certain places. He would get to determine where and when elections happen and how they're run. That would mean asserting his control over vote-by-mail or creating new restrictions around how people cast their ballots. This is not how our democracy was designed to function. The Constitution gives states the authority to administer elections. End of story. Our founders built a system meant to prevent exactly this kind of overreach. But for Trump, this isn't about making elections better; it's about consolidating authority in his own administration's hands. It's no surprise that every area he's talked about nationalizing is a large Democratic stronghold. Here's what Andy believes deeply: The Trump administration underestimates how much we value our freedom to vote and how seriously we take the responsibility of self-government. They underestimate the resolve of communities who understand that democracy only works when the rules are fair and the law is respected. We need a real check on this president, and we need real leaders who will uphold the Constitution, no matter what. In 2015, German Chancellor Angela Merkel uttered the infamous words "Wir schaffen das" ("We can do this"), unilaterally suspending the 2003 [Dublin Regulation](https://substack.com/redirect/55753946-578c-42c4-8d8d-23744e984d0c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and flinging open Europe's borders to over a million migrants, primarily from Syria, Afghanistan, and North Africa. This wasn't a humanitarian reflex but a calculated policy, as Merkel herself later admitted multiculturalism had "utterly failed" in Germany--yet she doubled down, inviting cultural chaos that would metastasize into the West's defining crisis of unchecked illegal immigration.

We now know from reports, primarily from Der Spiegel based on Snowden documents, that the NSA targeted Merkel's personal mobile phone as early as 2002 (during the Bush administration) and continued until at least 2013. The surveillance reportedly involved a listening unit in the U.S. Embassy in Berlin and included her phone number on an NSA target list.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9oZWFydGxhbmRqb3VybmFsLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.PtU-eS1qDsGb0kkK_JKslnOWqg8ivfmmg5-TPw5kcGE?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=188276432)
Obama publicly acknowledged the revelations damaged U.S.-German relations and perceptions of U.S. intelligence. He implemented reforms, including curbs on spying on allied leaders' communications.
The incident strained U.S.-German ties, with Merkel famously stating "spying among friends is not acceptable."

Far from an isolated German blunder, Merkel's decision ignited a domino effect, normalizing mass migration as a tool of globalist agendas, eroding national sovereignty, and fueling populist backlashes from Brexit to Trump's border wall.

Merkel's gamble began with Syrian refugees fleeing civil war, but it quickly devolved into an uncontrolled influx of economic opportunists and potential security threats. By 2016, Germany alone absorbed 1.2 million arrivals, straining welfare systems, housing, and public services to breaking point. [Sexual assaults in Cologne on New Year's Eve 2015](https://substack.com/redirect/de1f39b7-1352-4254-bfde-7f9413e1b618?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--perpetrated overwhelmingly by migrants--exposed the naivety, or worse, the deliberate blindness, to integration failures. Migrants from incompatible cultural backgrounds rejected Western values, forming parallel societies in cities like Berlin's Neukolln, where no-go zones emerged amid rising crime rates: violent offenses surged 10% in 2016, with non-citizens overrepresented in statistics.

Merkel knew the risks; her East German Stasi-honed pragmatism ensured she foresaw the backlash. Yet, she branded critics "Nazis," stifling dissent and entrenching a pro-migration orthodoxy across Europe.

The ripple effects were seismic. Merkel's signal acted as a beacon, drawing millions more to the continent via the Mediterranean route--over 1.5 million crossings by 2017, per UNHCR data. Balkan smuggling networks exploded, turning the EU into a porous sieve. Southern nations like Greece and Italy buckled under the weight, while Northern states faced secondary migrations, with Sweden's rape crisis (up 1,472% since 1975, largely migrant-linked) and [France's banlieue riots](https://substack.com/redirect/cf8cd6ec-0c9f-42c9-b7df-6ea7b9317ecf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) epitomizing the fracture. The EU's failed quota system only deepened divisions, as Hungary's Viktor Orban built fences Merkel decried as "un-European." By weaponizing guilt over Holocaust atonement, she globalized victimhood narratives, inspiring copycat policies from Canada's Trudeau to Biden's border reversals.

In the U.S., Merkel's shadow looms large. Her 2015 pivot echoed Obama's DACA expansions and sanctuary city proliferation, inviting Central American caravans that overwhelmed the southern border--over 10 million encounters since 2021. American "Merkels"--from Pelosi's open-tent rhetoric to Soros-funded NGOs ferrying migrants--mirror her blueprint: dismantle enforcement, reframe illegality as "humanity," and suppress data on costs (e.g., $150 billion annually in U.S. welfare for non-citizens). Deindustrialization followed suit; Merkel's nuclear shutdowns and green mandates gutted German manufacturing, paralleling U.S. offshoring that hollowed Rust Belt towns, now migrant influx flashpoints.

Merkel's defenders claim demographics demanded influxes for aging Europe, but this ignores her sabotage of family policies and the cultural erasure she enabled--Arabic over German in some schools, Sharia patrols in London. Her post-chancellorship silence as the AfD surges to 20% approval indicts her complicity. The West's immigration crisis--fractured communities, strained budgets, eroded trust--is her Frankenstein: a borderless utopia birthed in Berlin, now devouring democracies. Justice demands accountability; how many more "Merkels" must we unmask before reclaiming our civilizations?

clean_body: Texas builders just handed the GOP a blueprint--too bad it's labeled "Labor Shortage: Some Assembly Required. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more Texas builders just handed the GOP a blueprint--too bad it's labeled "Labor Shortage: Some Assembly Required. | | | Feb 17 | | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- In 2015, German Chancellor Angela Merkel uttered the infamous words "Wir schaffen das" ("We can do this"), unilaterally suspending the 2003 and flinging open Europe's borders to over a million migrants, primarily from Syria, Afghanistan, and North Africa. This wasn't a humanitarian reflex but a calculated policy, as Merkel herself later admitted multiculturalism had "utterly failed" in Germany--yet she doubled down, inviting cultural chaos that would metastasize into the West's defining crisis of unchecked illegal immigration. We now know from reports, primarily from Der Spiegel based on Snowden documents, that the NSA targeted Merkel's personal mobile phone as early as 2002 (during the Bush administration) and continued until at least 2013. The surveillance reportedly involved a listening unit in the U.S. Embassy in Berlin and included her phone number on an NSA target list. Obama publicly acknowledged the revelations damaged U.S.-German relations and perceptions of U.S. intelligence. He implemented reforms, including curbs on spying on allied leaders' communications. The incident strained U.S.-German ties, with Merkel famously stating "spying among friends is not acceptable." Far from an isolated German blunder, Merkel's decision ignited a domino effect, normalizing mass migration as a tool of globalist agendas, eroding national sovereignty, and fueling populist backlashes from Brexit to Trump's border wall. Merkel's gamble began with Syrian refugees fleeing civil war, but it quickly devolved into an uncontrolled influx of economic opportunists and potential security threats. By 2016, Germany alone absorbed 1.2 million arrivals, straining welfare systems, housing, and public services to breaking point. overwhelmingly by migrants--exposed the naivety, or worse, the deliberate blindness, to integration failures. Migrants from incompatible cultural backgrounds rejected Western values, forming parallel societies in cities like Berlin's Neukolln, where no-go zones emerged amid rising crime rates: violent offenses surged 10% in 2016, with non-citizens overrepresented in statistics. Merkel knew the risks; her East German Stasi-honed pragmatism ensured she foresaw the backlash. Yet, she branded critics "Nazis," stifling dissent and entrenching a pro-migration orthodoxy across Europe. The ripple effects were seismic. Merkel's signal acted as a beacon, drawing millions more to the continent via the Mediterranean route--over 1.5 million crossings by 2017, per UNHCR data. Balkan smuggling networks exploded, turning the EU into a porous sieve. Southern nations like Greece and Italy buckled under the weight, while Northern states faced secondary migrations, with Sweden's rape crisis (up 1,472% since 1975, largely migrant-linked) and epitomizing the fracture. The EU's failed quota system only deepened divisions, as Hungary's Viktor Orban built fences Merkel decried as "un-European." By weaponizing guilt over Holocaust atonement, she globalized victimhood narratives, inspiring copycat policies from Canada's Trudeau to Biden's border reversals. In the U.S., Merkel's shadow looms large. Her 2015 pivot echoed Obama's DACA expansions and sanctuary city proliferation, inviting Central American caravans that overwhelmed the southern border--over 10 million encounters since 2021. American "Merkels"--from Pelosi's open-tent rhetoric to Soros-funded NGOs ferrying migrants--mirror her blueprint: dismantle enforcement, reframe illegality as "humanity," and suppress data on costs (e.g., $150 billion annually in U.S. welfare for non-citizens). Deindustrialization followed suit; Merkel's nuclear shutdowns and green mandates gutted German manufacturing, paralleling U.S. offshoring that hollowed Rust Belt towns, now migrant influx flashpoints. Merkel's defenders claim demographics demanded influxes for aging Europe, but this ignores her sabotage of family policies and the cultural erasure she enabled--Arabic over German in some schools, Sharia patrols in London. Her post-chancellorship silence as the AfD surges to 20% approval indicts her complicity. The West's immigration crisis--fractured communities, strained budgets, eroded trust--is her Frankenstein: a borderless utopia birthed in Berlin, now devouring democracies. Justice demands accountability; how many more "Merkels" must we unmask before reclaiming our civilizations? Editorial comments expressed in this column are the sole opinion of the writer. My parents raised me with a core set of values — values that probably sound pretty familiar to many Pennsylvanians: Work hard. Give back. Stand up for others.
I thought about those values throughout my childhood and into young adulthood. I knew I wanted to serve my community in some way or another. But for years, I wasn’t sure how.
Then, the idea hit me: There’s no better way to serve the public than... public service. But not in the way many politicians view their work — putting _their_ interests folks, and the needs of their constituents last.
I wanted to do something different. So I ran for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives in a district Republicans controlled for twenty consecutive years. A lot of folks believed I wouldn’t stand a chance. But after we knocked on more than 18,000 doors throughout the district, we won, Derek. And I got right to work.
**As a State Representative, I helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history.**
Hear me on this: I was damn proud of what we accomplished in the Legislature. But I knew I could do more. So I ran for County Commissioner in Montgomery County, where I led a fiscal and ethical turnaround.
Soon, I took my fight statewide, serving as Pennsylvania Attorney General — where I worked to protect health care access for Pennsylvanians, get justice for survivors, and defend our democracy.
Then — not long after Donald Trump tried to overturn Pennsylvania’s election in 2020 — I decided to run for Governor. It wasn’t an easy decision. I knew that, as Governor, the buck would stop with me. All of the responsibility would fall on my shoulders. But I also knew Pennsylvanians were desperate for something different. A new kind of leadership in Harrisburg.
**Leadership focused on bringing people together. Not driving folks apart.**
So I ran, Derek. And we didn’t just win Pennsylvania. We sent an unmistakable message to the entire country in that election: Here in Pennsylvania, hope is stronger than fear. Results are more important than rhetoric. Unity will triumph over division.
Since Inauguration Day, I’ve taken those lessons to heart. That’s how we’ve accomplished so much progress for the good people of Pennsylvania — record funding for public schools, free breakfasts for our K-12 students, cutting taxes seven times for the folks who need it most — despite being one of just a handful of states with a divided legislature.
[_**But Derek, there’s still so much work left to do for the good people of Pennsylvania — and it’s going to take all of us standing together to get it done. If you’re just as ready as I am to tackle these challenges head-on, reject far-right extremism, and get sh*t done, I hope I can count on your support throughout this consequential election year.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/125579735/602244231/-1395620021?refcode=email_021726_decision&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500,1000&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhMWJjNDMyZC0zOTBjLWYxMTEtODMyZS0wMDIyNDgyYTk3MzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XOguRyAIRefK_Rb8wqQ9k0NTztvdlJ02Gyx-V0Z1usc=)
